facts.fact: According to eMarketer (as cited by the page), digital ads will comprise nearly 50% of all B2B ad spending in 2024.
facts.quote: According to eMarketer, digital ads will comprise nearly [50% of all B2B ad spending](https://www.insiderintelligence.com/content/what-transformation-b2b-ad-spending-means-marketers) in 2024.

facts.fact: The page recommends using dayparting to run B2B ads Monday to Friday, between 9:00am and 5:00pm.
facts.quote: leverage dayparting to make sure your ads run Monday to Friday, between 9:00am and 5:00pm.

facts.fact: Dayparting is a campaign parameter that lets advertisers set ads to run only at certain times of the day.
facts.quote: Dayparting is a common campaign parameter that allows you to set particular ads to run only at certain times of the day.

facts.fact: Traditional account-based marketing relies on physical-world activities such as events, and personalization at scale for target accounts is described on the page as a top challenge.
facts.quote: Traditional ABM has relied on physical-world activities like events where marketers get one-on-one time with the stakeholders at a target company.

facts.fact: Account-based marketing is defined as a B2B marketing strategy that concentrates marketing toward a set of specific accounts within a market.
facts.quote: Account-based marketing (ABM) is a business-to-business (B2B) marketing strategy that concentrates marketing toward a set of specific accounts within a market.

facts.fact: StackAdapt is partnered with LiveRamp, a data connectivity platform, to offer marketers an audience integration for generating CRM audiences.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is partnered with [LiveRamp](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/liveramp-partnership/), a data connectivity platform that enables us to offer marketers an audience integration.
